description: Connect to the game. auto (default): attach to the human's live game if `debuff dev` has it open in a browser, else start a private headless copy, paused. Returns the mode, state and how many notes the human has flagged. Replaces any running session.

page.description: Path to open in headless mode. Default "/".

reducedMotion.description: Force game.reducedMotion on or off for this session. Default: leave it; the state's reducedMotion says what it is. When true, games may freeze animations.

root.description: Project root. Absolute path, or relative to the server's root. Default: the server's root.

viewport.description: Headless only: browser viewport [width, height] in CSS pixels. Default [960, 540]. Try [390, 844] to test a scale: "expand" game in phone portrait.

name: game_start
title: Start game
